programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: The Cinque Terre Express runs along Italy's northern coast east of Genoa; passing through five UNESCO-listed villages, it offers coastal views and access to cobbled streets, harbors, terraced vineyards and pastel-colored houses.

programme.desc: The official live video for SO BE IT by Elevation Worship featuring Tiffany Hudson & Chris Brown.

programme.title: This Is My Bible
programme.desc: If you're walking through a season and you don't know what to do, open up your Bible and let it be a lamp to your feet and a light to your path.

programme.title: The Prayer That Repairs
programme.desc: Don't be so confused with the noise around you that you can't hear the God who made you; when you're faced with a struggle you didn't see coming, remember that Jesus is already praying for you; his prayer is stronger than any attack.

programme.title: Allow Joy To Reintroduce Himself
programme.desc: Real joy doesn't come from circumstances, it comes from Jesus. God isn't withholding joy from you; He's inviting you to find it right where you are. If you're looking for joy in hard times, start here.

programme.title: The Power of Dependency
programme.desc: Real healing requires true dependence on God because He didn't create you to carry the weight of life on your own; let go of self-sufficiency and trust the One who can truly make you whole.

programme.title: The God of Pieces
programme.desc: The devil wants to keep you overwhelmed by your situation, but God wants to show you how to deal with it piece by piece; as you learn to praise God for the piece you have, you'll experience the peace you've been praying for.

programme.title: The God of Pieces
programme.desc: The devil wants to keep you overwhelmed by your situation, but God wants to show you how to deal with it piece by piece; as you learn to praise God for the piece you have, you'll experience the peace you've been praying for.

programme.title: When God Says Let Go
programme.desc: Is faith being tested? When waiting on the details of what God has next, remember that God doesn't give a test without a lesson first, so if He's calling to let go of something, one can trust He's already provided one with what.

programme.title: Now Playing: Worship From Elevation
programme.desc: The official live video for SO BE IT by Elevation Worship featuring Tiffany Hudson & Chris Brown.

programme.title: Sinking In The Storm
programme.desc: When feeling like starting to sink in the storm, call on the name of Jesus. He's near, and He won't let anyone go down. Don't panic and obsess over the problem, because when one syncs up with Jesus, things can change just that quick.

programme.title: A Recipe for Resentment
programme.desc: If you've been feeling pulled in every direction, it might be time to pivot; God isn't asking you to do everything, He's asking you to stay close to Him.

programme.title: All I Know
programme.desc: When life feels uncertain, it's tempting to chase after answers. But peace doesn't come from knowing more, it comes from knowing God.

programme.title: Expecting Change
programme.desc: Theological teachings suggest that God intends to restore believers and transform their lives to influence others, providing outcomes that go beyond personal development.

programme.title: Expecting Change
programme.desc: Theological teachings suggest that God intends to restore believers and transform their lives to influence others, providing outcomes that go beyond personal development.

programme.title: Your Label Is Lying
programme.desc: This sermon is for someone who has been hearing the same lies from the enemy for so long that you've started to believe them; but you are not your issue; you are not your bad decision; it's time to interrupt your story with truth and leave the lies.

programme.title: It's Worth The Dirt
programme.desc: Wondering if you should give up because progress feels slow? Wisdom isn't choosing what's easiest, it's choosing what's worth it; if you're tempted to quit because it's hard, remember: God uses pressure and patience to prepare you for something.

programme.title: Delivered Daily
programme.desc: God, can You get me out of this? It's a prayer we've all prayed. But what if God's answer isn't escape, but endurance? What if His rescue comes one day at a time?

programme.title: It Still Works
programme.desc: Pastor Steven shows us through the life of Moses how faith often looks like taking action even while you feel full of doubt; God can do miracles when we have the courage to look our doubt in the face and do it anyway.

programme.title: I Thought It Was Through
programme.desc: When despair sets in, it's easy to assume it'll always be this way; but a shift in thinking can break that cycle; your thoughts have the power to disrupt your despair.

programme.title: Hand Him the Plan
programme.desc: Sometimes the battle in your mind is proof that God's trying to do something great in your heart; what you see isn't the full picture of what God has for you; when you hand God your plans, you make room for His purpose.

programme.title: Now Playing: Worship From Elevation
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: Now Playing: Worship From Elevation
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: With God There's Always A Meanwhile
programme.desc: When life feels discouraging, it's easy to wonder how God is at work. But even in the midst of pain and rejection, God is preparing you for something greater.

programme.title: He Answered
programme.desc: Pastor Steven shares three things to remember when life is hard; the enemy wants us circling the wilderness, but God will bring us through as we learn to repeat what leads to victory.

programme.title: Not as Long as My Song!
programme.desc: Hitting your limit isn't a sign of weakness; it's an invitation to shift your perspective; when the enemy brings the battle to your mind, remember that he only attacks what's valuable; God's goodness is your secret weapon to win the fight.

programme.title: The Power to Change Your Mind
programme.desc: God created us to look like a reflection of His love, but many of us still wrestle with a history that contaminates that image; when we cope with facades, we miss out on the freedom God has for us.

programme.title: God Prompts
programme.desc: We often ask God to do what we want, but faith starts with doing what He says; when you trust God as your good Father and follow His prompting, even small steps can unlock something big.

programme.title: Move It to the Middle
programme.desc: Stressed, insecure and stuck, that's how Moses felt, too; that wasn't the end of his story, and it's not yours, either; it's just the middle, there's hope past this chapter, and it's found by shifting your focus back to God.
